    • Method Detail

      • importRecordingExcludes

        public static void importRecordingExcludes(List<RecordingEntry> recordingEntries,
                                           Path projectPath)
        Loads and applies recording excludes to the provided list of RecordingEntry objects. If "Recording Exclude.csv" does not exist, this method returns without modifying anything.
        Parameters:
        recordingEntries - recordings to update in memory
        projectPath - project root folder containing /Viewer/Recording Exclude.csv

      • importRecordingExcludes

        public static void importRecordingExcludes(tech.tablesaw.api.Table recordingsTable,
                                           Path projectPath)
        Loads and applies recording excludes to the provided in-memory Recordings table. If "Recording Exclude.csv" does not exist, this method returns without modifying anything.
        Parameters:
        recordingsTable - Recordings table to update in memory
        projectPath - project root folder containing /Viewer/Recording Exclude.csv

      • loadRecordingExclude

        public static List<RecordingExclude> loadRecordingExclude(Path csvFile)
        Loads all rows from "Recording Exclude.csv" into a list of RecordingExclude objects. The file is expected to contain a column named Recording Name.
        Parameters:
        csvFile - path to Recording Exclude.csv
        Returns:
        list of parsed RecordingExclude objects (possibly empty)
